places.name: Belém Tower
places.ai_summary: Belém Tower, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is a historic fortress symbolizing Portugal's Age of Discoveries.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for stunning views.

places.name: Jerónimos Monastery
places.ai_summary: Jerónimos Monastery, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is a masterpiece of Manueline architecture and a symbol of Portugal's maritime heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Explore the cloisters for intricate details.

places.name: Castelo de São Jorge
places.ai_summary: Castelo de São Jorge, overlooking Lisbon, is a historic castle offering panoramic views and a glimpse into the city's Moorish past.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the view from the terrace.
places.address: R. de Santa Cruz do Castelo, 1100-129 Lisbon, Portugal

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:Atlas Van der Hagen-KW1049B12 017-PORTUGALLIAE et ALGARBIAE REGNA.jpeg

attribution.title: PORTUGALLIAE et ALGARBIAE REGNA
attribution.author: Nicolaes Visscher II / Nicolaes Visscher II
attribution.credit: This digital media file - and/or the physical objects depicted on it - originates from the digital and/or physical collections of the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, national library of the Netherlands.
attribution.description: Map of Portugal, published in the eighties of the 17th century by Nicolaes Visscher II (1649-1702). It is probably based on a map of the cartographer Pedro Texeira Albernaz (died 1662), who published a general map of Portugal in 1662. His map was used more than a hundred years as a source for many maps of the kingdom.

places.name: Alfama District
places.ai_summary: Alfama, the oldest district in Lisbon, is known for its narrow streets, traditional Fado music, and historic buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Fado museums and enjoy a live performance.

places.name: Praça do Comércio
places.ai_summary: Praça do Comércio, also known as Terreiro do Paço, is a large waterfront square in Lisbon, rich in history and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Some buildings around the square may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the terrace cafes.

places.name: Santa Justa Lift
places.ai_summary: The Santa Justa Lift is an iconic elevator in Lisbon, connecting the lower streets of the Baixa with the higher Largo do Carmo.

opening_hours.notes: Last ticket sold at 10:50 PM.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Carmo Convent ruins.

attribution.title: Bandeira municipal de Lisboa
attribution.author: Sérgio Horta, a partir de orginal de Ornellas e outros

places.name: LX Factory
places.ai_summary: LX Factory is a trendy spot in Lisbon, known for its vibrant street art, shops, and eateries, located in a former industrial complex.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops and restaurants may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Check out the Ler Devagar bookstore and the street art.
places.address: R. Rodrigues de Faria 103, 1300-501 Lisbon, Portugal

places.name: 25 de Abril Bridge
places.ai_summary: The 25 de Abril Bridge is a suspension bridge connecting Lisbon to Almada, often compared to San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge.

opening_hours.notes: Pedestrian access is limited to certain hours.

places.place_tip: Walk or bike across for stunning views of Lisbon.

places.name: Time Out Market
places.ai_summary: Time Out Market is a food hall in Lisbon, featuring a variety of stalls from top chefs and local eateries, offering a taste of the city's culinary scene.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary for individual vendors.

places.place_tip: Try the pastel de nata and bacalhau à brás.

places.name: Rossio Square
places.ai_summary: Rossio Square, also known as Praça do Rossio, is a lively square in the heart of Lisbon, known for its wave-patterned cobblestones and historic significance.

opening_hours.notes: Surrounding shops and cafes may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at the historic Café A Brasileira.

attribution.title: Bandeira municipal de Lisboa
attribution.author: Sérgio Horta, a partir de orginal de Ornellas e outros

places.name: Lisbon Cathedral (Sé de Lisboa)
places.ai_summary: Lisbon Cathedral, also known as Sé de Lisboa, is the oldest and most important church in the city, featuring a mix of architectural styles.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 6:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a panoramic view of the city.

attribution.title: AfonsoI-P
attribution.author: unknown, uploaded by en:User:Muriel_Gottrop or de:User:Rhino
attribution.description: Picture of king Afonso I of Portugal.

places.name: Padrão dos Descobrimentos
places.ai_summary: Padrão dos Descobrimentos, or the Monument to the Discoveries, celebrates the Portuguese Age of Discovery and its notable figures.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on January 1st, Easter Sunday, May 1st, and December 25th.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the nearby Jerónimos Monastery.

places.name: National Tile Museum (Museu do Azulejo)
places.ai_summary: The National Tile Museum in Lisbon is dedicated to the preservation and promotion of the Portuguese tile, or azulejo, showcasing its history and art.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chapel covered in azulejos.
places.address: R. da Madre de Deus, 4, 1900-312 Lisbon, Portugal

places.name: Calouste Gulbenkian Museum
places.ai_summary: The Calouste Gulbenkian Museum in Lisbon houses an extensive collection of ancient and modern art, including works by European masters.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays.

places.place_tip: Check out the beautiful gardens as well.

places.name: Oceanário de Lisboa
places.ai_summary: The Oceanário de Lisboa is one of the world's largest aquariums, located in Lisbon, showcasing a vast array of marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 7:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit the shark tunnel and the coral reef exhibit.
places.address: Esplanada Dom Carlos I, 1990-005 Lisbon, Portugal

places.name: Tram 28 Route
places.ai_summary: Tram 28 is a famous vintage tram route in Lisbon, offering a scenic ride through the city's historic neighborhoods.

opening_hours.notes: Trams run every 20 minutes.

places.place_tip: Validate your ticket before boarding.

attribution.title: Bandeira municipal de Lisboa
attribution.author: Sérgio Horta, a partir de orginal de Ornellas e outros

places.name: Chiado District
places.ai_summary: Chiado is a trendy and cultural district in Lisbon, known for its historic sites, shopping, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops and cafes may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Bertrand Bookstore, the world's oldest operating bookstore.

places.name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
places.ai_summary: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte is a viewpoint in Lisbon, offering one of the best panoramic views of the city.
places.name_english: Our Lady of the Hill Viewpoint

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.
places.address: R. da Senhora do Monte, 1100-392 Lisbon, Portugal

places.name: Carmo Convent Ruins
places.ai_summary: The Carmo Convent Ruins are the remnants of a 14th-century convent in Lisbon, known for its Gothic architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Santa Justa Lift.

places.name: MAAT – Museum of Art, Architecture and Technology
places.ai_summary: MAAT is a contemporary museum in Lisbon, dedicated to art, architecture, and technology, located by the Tagus River.
places.name_english: MAAT – Museum of Art, Architecture and Technology

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and some holidays.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for temporary exhibitions.
